name: taskplane
description: Build and review robust code with enforced readiness, evidence-backed completion, scoped execution, and technical-consequence lenses.

interface.longDescription: taskplane helps heavy AI coding users build and review robust features. Definition of Ready blocks under-specified work; scoped contracts constrain execution; evidence-backed Definition of Done blocks unproven completion; and a full 25-lens engineering review exposes architecture, security, operability, data, UX, and other technical consequences for technical and nontechnical decision-makers.
capabilities: Enforce Definition of Ready before implementation begins
Constrain execution to an approved task scope
Require evidence-backed Definition of Done before sign-off
Publish progress artifacts for team handoff
defaultPrompt: Use taskplane to plan and implement this feature with approval gates.
Use taskplane to review this branch without changing code.
Show the current taskplane run status and what needs my decision.
